title: How CTV can benefit all brands, big and small | Partner Content | Campaign Asia

facts.fact: An eMarketer forecast cited in the article projects that Asia-Pacific will add 167.8 million sub-OTT video users between 2023 and 2027, which the article says is 55% of global users.
The article states that new AVOD platforms in Asia offer a route to reach diverse audiences with a total population of close to 700 million.
facts.quote: a total population of close to 700 million

facts.fact: According to Pixalate, open programmatic CTV ad spend in APAC rose 43% in Q1 2024 compared with Q1 2023.
facts.quote: there was a 43% rise in open programmatic CTV ad spend in APAC in Q1 of 2024, as compared with 2023

facts.fact: The article states that CTV ads usually run for 15 to 30 seconds.
facts.quote: Ads usually run for 15 seconds - 30 seconds

facts.fact: The article states, without a cited source, that seven out of ten people in Indonesia have access to CTV.
facts.quote: Already seven out of ten people in Indonesia have access to CTV.
